1.web: “Hear this, house of Jacob, you who are called by the name of Israel, and have come out of the waters of Judah; who swear by Yahweh’s name, and make mention of the God of Israel, but not in truth, nor in righteousness
1.asv: Hear ye this, O house of Jacob, who are called by the name of Israel, and are come forth out of the waters of Judah; who swear by the name of Jehovah, and make mention of the God of Israel, but not in truth, nor in righteousness

2.web: (for they call themselves of the holy city, and stay themselves on the God of Israel; Yahweh of Armies is his name):
2.asv: (for they call themselves of the holy city, and stay themselves upon the God of Israel; Jehovah of hosts is his name):

3.web: I have declared the former things from of old; yes, they went out of my mouth, and I showed them: suddenly I did them, and they happened.
3.asv: I have declared the former things from of old; yea, they went forth out of my mouth, and I showed them: suddenly I did them, and they came to pass.

4.web: Because I knew that you are obstinate, and your neck is an iron sinew, and your brow brass;
4.asv: Because I knew that thou art obstinate, and thy neck is an iron sinew, and thy brow brass;

5.web: therefore I have declared it to you from of old; before it came to pass I showed it to you; lest you should say, ‘My idol has done them, and my engraved image, and my molten image, has commanded them.’
5.asv: therefore I have declared it to thee from of old; before it came to pass I showed it thee; lest thou shouldest say, Mine idol hath done them, and my graven image, and my molten image, hath commanded them.

6.web: You have heard it; see all this; and you, will you not declare it? “I have shown you new things from this time, even hidden things, which you have not known.
6.asv: Thou hast heard it; behold all this; and ye, will ye not declare it? I have showed thee new things from this time, even hidden things, which thou hast not known.

7.web: They are created now, and not from of old; and before this day you didn’t hear them; lest you should say, ‘Behold, I knew them.’
7.asv: They are created now, and not from of old; and before this day thou heardest them not; lest thou shouldest say, Behold, I knew them.

8.web: Yes, you didn’t hear; yes, you didn’t know; yes, from of old your ear was not opened: for I knew that you dealt very treacherously, and was called a transgressor from the womb.
8.asv: Yea, thou heardest not; yea, thou knewest not; yea, from of old thine ear was not opened: for I knew that thou didst deal very treacherously, and wast called a transgressor from the womb.

9.web: For my name’s sake will I defer my anger, and for my praise will I refrain for you, that I not cut you off.
9.asv: For my name’s sake will I defer mine anger, and for my praise will I refrain for thee, that I cut thee not off.

10.web: Behold, I have refined you, but not as silver; I have chosen you in the furnace of affliction.
10.asv: Behold, I have refined thee, but not as silver; I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.

11.web: For my own sake, for my own sake, will I do it; for how should my name be profaned? I will not give my glory to another.
11.asv: For mine own sake, for mine own sake, will I do it; for how should my name be profaned? and my glory will I not give to another.

12.web: “Listen to me, O Jacob, and Israel my called: I am he; I am the first, I also am the last.
12.asv: Hearken unto me, O Jacob, and Israel my called: I am he; I am the first, I also am the last.

13.web: Yes, my hand has laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand has spread out the heavens: when I call to them, they stand up together.
13.asv: Yea, my hand hath laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand hath spread out the heavens: when I call unto them, they stand up together.

14.web: “Assemble yourselves, all you, and hear; who among them has declared these things? He whom Yahweh loves shall perform his pleasure on Babylon, and his arm shall be on the Chaldeans.
14.asv: Assemble yourselves, all ye, and hear; who among them hath declared these things? He whom Jehovah loveth shall perform his pleasure on Babylon, and his arm shall be on the Chaldeans.

15.web: I, even I, have spoken; yes, I have called him; I have brought him, and he shall make his way prosperous.
15.asv: I, even I, have spoken; yea, I have called him; I have brought him, and he shall make his way prosperous.

16.web: “Come near to me and hear this: “From the beginning I have not spoken in secret; from the time that it was, there am I.” Now the Lord Yahweh has sent me, with his Spirit.
16.asv: Come ye near unto me, hear ye this; from the beginning I have not spoken in secret; from the time that it was, there am I: and now the Lord Jehovah hath sent me, and his Spirit.

17.web: Thus says Yahweh, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: I am Yahweh your God, who teaches you to profit, who leads you by the way that you should go.
17.asv: Thus saith Jehovah, thy Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: I am Jehovah thy God, who teacheth thee to profit, who leadeth thee by the way that thou shouldest go.

18.web: Oh that you had listened to my commandments! then your peace would have been like a river, and your righteousness like the waves of the sea:
18.asv: Oh that thou hadst hearkened to my commandments! then had thy peace been as a river, and thy righteousness as the waves of the sea:

19.web: your seed also had been as the sand, and the offspring of your body like its grains: his name would not be cut off nor destroyed from before me.
19.asv: thy seed also had been as the sand, and the offspring of thy bowels like the grains thereof: his name would not be cut off nor destroyed from before me.

20.web: Leave Babylon! Flee from the Chaldeans. With a voice of singing declare, tell this, utter it even to the end of the earth: say, Yahweh has redeemed his servant Jacob.
20.asv: Go ye forth from Babylon, flee ye from the Chaldeans; with a voice of singing declare ye, tell this, utter it even to the end of the earth: say ye, Jehovah hath redeemed his servant Jacob.

21.web: They didn’t thirst when he led them through the deserts; he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them; he split the rock also, and the waters gushed out.
21.asv: And they thirsted not when he led them through the deserts; he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them; he clave the rock also, and the waters gushed out.

22.web: “There is no peace”, says Yahweh, “for the wicked.”
22.asv: There is no peace, saith Jehovah, to the wicked.
